questions.text: A cheetah covers 30 metres every second. How many seconds does it take to cover 90 metres?
A tennis set finishes 6-4. How many games were played in it?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
questions.why: MINUTE has one M, MOMENT has two and A THOUSAND YEARS has none.

questions.text: Mary's father has five daughters: Nana, Nene, Nini, Nono and ___?
questions.why: The question starts "Mary's father", so Mary herself is the fifth daughter.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 3, 5, 9, 11, 13, 17?
questions.why: All the others are prime; 9 is 3 × 3.

questions.text: What is half of two plus two?
questions.why: You halve two first and then add two: 1 + 2 = 3.

questions.text: What is the sum of all the numbers on a standard dartboard, 1 to 20?
questions.why: Pair the numbers as 1+20, 2+19 and so on: that's 10 pairs of 21, which is 210.

questions.text: How many letters appear exactly once in SHERLOCK HOLMES?
questions.why: S, H, E, L and O each appear twice; R, C, K and M appear once.

questions.text: Which two-digit number has digits that add up to 11, and gets 9 bigger when you swap its digits round?

questions.why: Write the difference then the sum: 5 − 3 = 2 and 5 + 3 = 8 give 28, so 5 − 4 = 1 and 5 + 4 = 9 give 19.

questions.text: What is the smallest number that, when written in words, has its letters in alphabetical order?
questions.why: The letters of FORTY run F, O, R, T, Y in alphabetical order, and no number word from one to thirty-nine does.
